write.docs: This [Action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) sends a defined UART signal to the given UART bus.

baud_rate.docs:
**int**: The baud rate of the UART bus.

*See also: [UART Bus](https://esphome.io/components/uart#configuration-variables)*

data_bits.docs:
**int**: The number of data bits used on the UART bus. Options: 5 to 8. Defaults to 8.

*See also: [UART Bus](https://esphome.io/components/uart#configuration-variables)*

debug.docs:
**mapping**: Options for debugging communication on the UART hub, see [Debugging](https://esphome.io/components/uart#debugging).

*See also: [UART Bus](https://esphome.io/components/uart#configuration-variables)*

flow_control_pin.docs:
**[Pin](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin)**: ESP32 only. The pin used to for hardware RS485 flow control. Use of this setting enables half-duplex mode. Use the full pin schema and set `inverted: true` to invert logic levels.

*See also: [UART Bus](https://esphome.io/components/uart#configuration-variables)*

flush_timeout.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: ESP32 only. The maximum time to wait for the TX FIFO to drain when `flush()` is called. If the TX FIFO does not drain within this time, `flush()` returns a `TIMEOUT` result. When not set, `flush()` waits indefinitely.

*See also: [UART Bus](https://esphome.io/components/uart#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID for this UART hub if you need multiple UART hubs.

*See also: [UART Bus](https://esphome.io/components/uart#configuration-variables)*

parity.docs:
The parity used on the UART bus. Options: `NONE`, `EVEN`, `ODD`. Defaults to `NONE`.

*See also: [UART Bus](https://esphome.io/components/uart#configuration-variables)*

port.docs:
**string**: Host platform only. Unix style name of the port to use.

*See also: [UART Bus](https://esphome.io/components/uart#configuration-variables)*

rx_buffer_size.docs:
**int**: The size of the buffer used for receiving UART messages. Increase if you use an integration that needs to read big payloads from UART. Defaults to `256`.

*See also: [UART Bus](https://esphome.io/components/uart#configuration-variables)*

rx_full_threshold.docs:
**int**: ESP32 only. After receiving this number of bytes, the data becomes available for processing. The default is calculated at compilation time to be approximately ten milliseconds (about 8 bytes at 9600 baud, 114 bytes at 115200 baud).

*See also: [UART Bus](https://esphome.io/components/uart#configuration-variables)*

rx_pin.docs:
**[Pin](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin)**: The pin to receive data on from the ESP's perspective. Use the full pin schema and set `inverted: true` to invert logic levels. Not supported by host platform.

*See also: [UART Bus](https://esphome.io/components/uart#configuration-variables)*

rx_timeout.docs:
**int**: ESP32 only. This value specifies a number of bytes used to determine the duration of the timeout. The duration of the timeout is based on the amount of time it would take to receive this number of bytes. In other words, for a given value and baud rate, doubling the baud rate will halve the duration of the timeout. After the timeout has elapsed, the data becomes available for processing. Defaults to `2`.

*See also: [UART Bus](https://esphome.io/components/uart#configuration-variables)*

stop_bits.docs:
**int**: The number of stop bits to send. Options: 1, 2. Defaults to 1.

*See also: [UART Bus](https://esphome.io/components/uart#configuration-variables)*

tx_pin.docs:
**[Pin](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin)**: The pin to send data to from the ESP's perspective. Use the full pin schema and set `inverted: true` to invert logic levels. Not supported by host platform.

*See also: [UART Bus](https://esphome.io/components/uart#configuration-variables)*

uart_id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The ID of the UART bus to use.

*See also: [UFM-01 Flow Meter](https://esphome.io/components/ufm01#configuration-variables)*
